summary: Tested the new admin dashboard, verified-buyer reviews, live pricing and partner routing, end to end. Backend: 24 new pytest tests in test_admin_reviews_pricing.py, all passing. They cover pricing defaults and the 401 and 422 validation (0, 5001, bundle>single, missing field); orders using the edited prices (320/290/260: qty1=320, qty3=3x290, subscribe 2x260) and then reset; admin orders shape, region from the postal sector, time_slot, sgt_time, customer and stats consistency (sum(by_hour)==orders, revenue==sum(totals)) and the days filter; reviews returning 400 for a mismatched email or unknown order, 422 for rating 0 or 6, a short body or a 1-char name, case-insensitive order and email, 201 pending, 409 for a duplicate, approved-only public listing, approve/reject/all filters and 404/422 on admin decisions; and clinic applications saved and listed. Partner email_status is failed:undeliverable_recipient for partner@smoothscar.com, as expected (Resend says it can't verify the recipient). Frontend at 390x844: the landing Reviews section shows the summary, cards and write-review-button, and the widget prices come from /api/pricing. A one-time checkout produced an order, and order-write-review-button prefilled /review with order, email and first name. Rating and body validation errors showed, the 4-star label read 'Very good', review-success appeared, and a duplicate or bad order showed review-submit-error with the server message. Admin: a wrong passcode showed 'Incorrect passcode' and login worked by button and by Enter. Orders showed stats, period chips 7/30/90/0, search by order number and by email, and Export CSV downloaded with the correct headers. Reviews: approving moved the review to Live and it appeared on the landing page (avg 4.5, 2 reviews); Hide moved it to Hidden. Partners listed 5 applications. Pricing at 310/280/260 updated the preview and the landing widget ($310/$560/$260), the bundle>single server error message showed, and prices were reset to 300/275/275. A subscribe checkout of 4 boxes gave $1,100 and an Auto-Ship order page. No page errors. Minor UI issues are listed below.

minor.issue: Stats are computed in Python over at most 1000 orders (limit(1000)). Once there are more than 1000 orders in the period, the revenue, region and hour stats silently undercount. Use a Mongo aggregation for the stats and paginate the rows.

Buyer check uses email_key, which strips +labels and dots. So j.ane+x@example.com matches an order placed as jane@example.com. The order number is still required, so the risk is low, but it is not an exact email match.

partner@smoothscar.com is rejected by Resend (422 undeliverable_recipient, 'couldn't verify'). The application is saved, but no one is notified until the domain has MX records or the address is verified.

ui_bugs.issue: No client-side check that bundle <= single. Save stays enabled with bundle 320 > single 300, and the user only finds out after the server returns 422 (the message itself shows correctly). parseInt is also lax ('12.5' becomes 12, '300abc' becomes 300).
At 390px the revenue '$14,870' wraps mid-number into '$14,87' / '0'. Use adjustsFontSizeToFit with numberOfLines={1}, or a smaller font or a wider tile.

issues: At 390px the 'Pricing' tab is clipped at the right edge (the horizontal scroll isn't obvious). Reduce the tab padding so all 4 fit, or left-align the tabs.
The default browser focus outline draws a black rectangle inside the rounded input. Set outlineStyle: 'none' on web.
email_status (e.g. failed:undeliverable_recipient) is not shown, so the team can't tell that notification emails are failing.

action_items: Fix the revenue stat tile wrapping mid-number on mobile (OrderStats tileValue: numberOfLines={1} plus adjustsFontSizeToFit).
PricingTab: add a client-side bundle<=single check with an inline error, and use strict integer parsing.
Make all 4 admin tabs fit at 390px, or make the scroll obvious.
Optional: show email_status in the Partners tab, and compute admin order stats with an aggregation instead of the 1000-doc limit.

Update stale older tests: test_orders.py (old prices 270/1080 and the removed clinic plan) and test_clinic_and_email.py. Those suites also hit the per-IP rate limits (orders 20/h, clinic 5/h), because random X-Forwarded-For values go leftmost and client_ip uses the rightmost entry.
critical_code_review_comments: usePrices uses a 60s staleTime. If an admin changes prices while a customer is mid-checkout, the order is charged the new server price while the old price is displayed. Consider refetching pricing on checkout mount, or returning a price-changed notice.
The admin passcode lives only in React state, so the admin must log in again after every reload. That is acceptable by design.
Reviews: there is a unique index on order_number plus a pre-check, so duplicates are handled correctly. The public view does not leak customer_email.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows working; 2 minor UI bugs plus design nits

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ orders (@example.com), including BRNA-261102-0119 (one-time, review submitted then approved then hidden) and BRNA-261102-0120 (subscribe x4). Test reviews were left rejected (hidden). Prices were reset to 300/275/275. The public reviews endpoint still shows only the original approved review (count 1).
